name: Sycamore
overview: The sycamore tree, abundant in the land of Canaan, is noted in Scripture both for its practical value and symbolic significance. It was cultivated and cared for, providing fruit as Amos describes himself as a gatherer of sycomore fruit, and it also appears in the story of Zacchaeus, who climbed a sycamore tree to see Jesus. However, the sycamore was vulnerable to natural destruction, as seen when frost destroyed these trees, and it was sometimes cut down as mentioned in Isaiah, reflecting themes of judgment and restoration.
